tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over tools (topics) and their sources. Matches names, roles, regions, detection signals (files, dependencies, env vars), source titles and URLs. Every word must match, as a prefix.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: All sources (llms.txt, docs, MCP servers, skills, rules), detection signals and the role of one tool, by id such as `vercel`, `nextjs` or `drizzle`.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every tool in the catalog with its id, name, role and region, without sources. Use it to find candidates per role, then get_topic and their llms.txt sources to compare them.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "search" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Full-text search over tools (topics) and their sources. Matches names, roles, regions, detection signals (files, dependencies, env vars), source titles and URLs…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
